title: •Blizzard 2
caption: •Blizzard 2 (V)
game_text: May add 1 pilot and 8 passengers. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. During your control phase, may ▲ one Trample or Walker Barrage. Walker Barrage total is +2. Immune to attrition < 4.
lore: AT-AT commanded by the treacherous General Nevar before he was assassinated. Fortified with an extra layer of armor by the paranoid general. *Enclosed*.

notes: Unique (•). Scomp-link ring at the top-left of the text box → scomp true. Icon column: one yellow square with a black pilot figure = Permanent Pilot → 'permanent-pilot'. Slip deploy 6 / forfeit 6 (same as printed). Lore corrected from the scan: 'Enclosed' is printed in bold (keyword) → *Enclosed*. The wiki's default 'Blizzard 2' page carries Glossary 2.0 errata text and the 745 px Hoth-D-blizzard2.gif is the PC Errata face (D-E1) — downloaded, not used; printed face = 'Blizzard 2 (Original)' → Hoth-D-blizzard2-decipher-archive.gif (350×490) used. Modern: V0-D-blizzard2.gif (745) used; VB2 -pre and non-pre (350) also downloaded. Copyright 1996 legible on the 745 face.
